name: social.walletlink/wallet-identity
title: walletlink.social
description: Resolve wallet addresses to X and Farcaster accounts, and back again.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer wts_live_... An API key from https://walletlink.social, self-serve for any account holding credits. Not needed by a client that supports OAuth: this server is an OAuth 2.1 resource, and a tool call with no credential answers 401 naming its protected resource metadata. Tool discovery needs neither.
